title: Seven percent of ANZ code in past six months generated by AI
headline: ANZ reports seven percent of code generated by AI over six months
summary: ANZ Banking Group CEO Shayne Elliott reported that over seven percent of the bank's code was generated by AI during the past six months. The bank is integrating generative AI into its digital platforms, ANZ Plus and Transactive, as part of a broader strategy to simplify its technology stack and decommission legacy systems. ANZ has formally sanctioned teams to explore generative AI and is developing prototypes with an external partner.
why_it_matters: The integration of AI into critical software engineering pipelines at a major financial institution highlights the need for robust governance and quality assurance frameworks to manage the risks associated with AI-generated code in production environments.
